objective: Bring 20 loads of Searing Coral to Klockmort Spannerspan in Ironforge.

description: I want to try Furen Longbeard's new techniques on my own piece of armor.  And because you helped Furen and he helped me, you're welcome to the armor after I make it!
To finish the piece, I need a special coral, searing coral.  It grows in only one place--along the coast south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.
Bring me enough searing coral and I'll get right to work on the armor.  And hurry, <name>.  I'm so eager to get started it's making my toes twist!
progress: Hello hello, <name>! Do you have the searing coral? I can't wait to get to work!
completion: That's the stuff! Well done! Now let me get this smelted and hammered so I can apply Furen's technique with my own and then we can see what happens!
Oh my, oh my! I just know the armor will be very very very tough!
